universe: PERMNOs in the signal-date SPY weight table
short_history_pre_delisting: benchmark weight in continuous solve; zero execution target
risk_constraint_stage: before execution overrides and integer rounding
split_day_order_policy: Cancel all discretionary orders in a splitting security; process corporate actions and CIL normally.
stage_two_acceptance: optimal or optimal_inaccurate; independent constraints, objectives, dual residual <= 1e-8 and absolute/relative gap <= 1e-10
historical_prefix: None; new evolving account from cash
stage_one_candidates: det200: 3 starts x 200; feasible initial/major iterates/endpoints; <=10bp TE-violating endpoint repair; max 3 distinct directions
loss_definition: existing lot: shares * signal close < adjusted basis
direction_rule: loss stocks only; sign(stage1 weight - current weight); BUY/SELL/HOLD
settlement: Original sales, scheduled tax, original buys
candidate_ranking: Stage-one wash-adjusted objective for direction pool; original stage-two objective for final candidate selection
stage_one_tax: Fixed net-fee LTFO allocation plus exact past-30-calendar-day matching disallowance and historical-loss reversals
stage_two_tax: Original LTFO tax, no wash adjustment
future_wash_policy: No assumed future buys; no new buy restriction; actual ledger handles subsequent matches
wash_implementation: Immutable ledger-derived view, compiled piecewise-affine curves, per-month independent ledger checks
